iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: Day 43. Ceasefire holding Day 2. CRITICAL DISCREPANCY: Iran's Farsi ceasefire doc includes 'acceptance of uranium enrichment' but English version does NOT. Iran refuses to give up enrichment; Trump says it'll be 'taken care of'. CNN reports US/Israel determined to 'wipe out Iran's nuclear expertise' before wind-down. IAEA still withdrawn. Enrichment continues ~60%. Bushehr struck Apr 4-5. Mobilization: LOW (forces drawing down). Technical: CRITICAL unchanged. Ceasefire fragile - only 2 weeks. Enrichment dispute could collapse deal.

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: Day 43. Ceasefire holding Day 2. Strait of Hormuz reopening with coordination. Trump pulled back from 'destroy every power plant' threat. Israel operations in Lebanon NOT covered by ceasefire. Fragile - only 2 weeks. Mobilization: LOW (de-escalating). Cyber warfare ongoing. Conditional on Hormuz coordination.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel–Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: Day 43. ⚠️ MAJOR ESCALATION: Israel carried out DEADLIEST strikes on Lebanon since war began - 254 killed. 50 Israeli jets dropped 160 bombs. Hezbollah PAUSED attacks under ceasefire framework but Israel EXPLOITED this. Netanyahu explicitly: ceasefire 'does not include Lebanon'. VP Vance confirms Lebanon not in deal. Israel Defense Minister Katz warned Hezbollah leader Qassem 'his turn will come'. Hezbollah condemned but did not resume firing. Lebanese FM Aoun called attacks 'barbaric'. Arab League accused Israel of 'seeking to sabotage ceasefire'. Rhetoric: CRITICAL. Mobilization: CRITICAL. Israel using Iran ceasefire to concentrate firepower on Lebanon.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: No significant changes. OSW analysis: Turkey playing strategic ambiguity - refraining from explicit nuclear declarations while outlining red lines. FM Fidan: Iran ambitions could push Turkey into nuclear arms race. NATO B61-12 production concluding 2026; Turkey excluded from B61-12. Akkuyu NPP commissioning on track. MEF analysis: Turkey building two halves of nuclear deterrent. Stable.

india.name: India–Pakistan
india.notes: US Intelligence assessment: India-Pakistan ties 'remain a risk for nuclear conflict' (The Hindu Apr 2026). Diplomatic Insight: Kashmir 'nuclear flashpoint' post-May 2025 conflict. CFR 'Conflicts to Watch 2026': moderate likelihood of renewed conflict. May 2025 short war legacy continues. Nuclear facility lists exchanged Jan 1 2026 (confidence-building). Stable risk elevation.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: New START expired Feb 4 2026 - NO replacement. Bulletin: 'full-blown arms race' underway. Carnegie: Putin prioritizes nuclear THREAT over modernization - Strategic Rocket Forces at 90% (missed 95% target). GLOBSEC: Russia hybrid warfare escalating in 2026. Lavrov warns world pushing Middle East to acquire nukes. 136+ nuclear signaling incidents since Ukraine invasion. Structural risk unchanged at 60%.

china.name: China
china.notes: CNN investigation Apr 1 confirmed: China secretly expanding nuclear weapons infrastructure. Testing new generation nuclear warheads. Massive surge in missile production sites. Developing low-yield tactical nuclear weapons. HOWEVER: ISW/AEI Apr 3: No significant PLA activity changes. Taiwan Strait stable. KMT delegation visiting China. Taiwan budget delay threatens $2.4B weapons. Technical: CRITICAL (infrastructure expansion confirmed). Rising to 11%. Long-term buildup accelerating.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: ESCALATING: SECOND missile launch in 2 days (Apr 8). Multiple short-range ballistic missiles fired. Jang Kum-chol (VP FM): South Korea 'most hostile enemy state'. Kim Jong Un observed cruise missile test from new destroyer, 10 missiles fired from multiple rocket launchers. Kim demands US nuclear recognition as precondition. Constitutional nuclear status 'irreversible'. Submarine missile test anticipated. Polymarket tracking missile test probability. Rhetoric: CRITICAL. Probability UP to 87%.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia–Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: War Year 4, Day 1140+. ISW daily assessments through Apr 5. Arms Control Association: Russia concocting fresh 'Ukrainian bomb' claims - potential pretext for nuclear escalation. Moscow Times: Kremlin warns of Ukraine acquiring nukes from West. GCRI: nuclear escalation risk elevated if Russia perceives failure. Bulletin: 'innovative and potentially destabilizing military tactics'. Oreshnik systems being prepared. Stable at 83%.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan–Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: China-brokered peace talks continuing in Urumqi (Apr 2-3 confirmed ongoing). AP Exclusive: first round of talks held. China 'actively mediating' (FM Mao Ning). Talks may last days. Al Jazeera: 'worst conflict since Taliban return in 2021' but diplomatic track holding. UN experts urged fresh ceasefire. TTP ceasefire for Eid. Verification mechanism for Afghan territory being discussed. Diplomatic: HIGH (up from MEDIUM). Probability DOWN to 13%.
